text: That evening: Holmes says the bed must always stay in the same position to the ventilator and the rope
why: Holmes says this at the Crown Inn in the gathering darkness on the day of the visit.

text: Why was the bed in the middle room clamped to the floor? — to keep the bed always in the same position to the ventilator and the rope
id: q.why_bed_clamped=to keep the bed always in the same position to the ventilator and the rope
why: Holmes says the bed is clamped, cannot be moved, and must stay in the same relative position to the ventilator and rope.

text: What, if anything, came through the ventilator into that room? — it has to arrive at one spot: the bed is kept always in the same position to the ventilator and the rope
why: No one has said anything travels through the ventilator; 'it has to arrive at one spot' asserts a delivery to the bed that goes beyond Holmes's statement and hints at the mechanism.

text: What was the bell-rope put there for? — the bed is clamped so as to stay always in the same position to the rope and the ventilator
why: Directly restates Holmes's remark about the clamped bed and its fixed position relative to rope and ventilator.

text: What was the bell-rope put there for? — it was clearly never meant for a bell-pull
why: Holmes says the rope was clearly never meant for a bell-pull.

text: What was the ventilator really put there for? — the bed is clamped so as to stay always in the same position to the ventilator
why: Directly restates Holmes's remark that the clamped bed stays in the same position relative to the ventilator.

text: Why would Helen have to be moved into the middle room in particular? — the bed cannot be moved from its place by the ventilator and the rope, so the sleeper has to be brought to it
why: Helen believes the repairs were an excuse to move her, and Holmes has shown the bed cannot move, so the sleeper must come to it; this follows plainly.

text: Why was the bed in the middle room clamped to the floor? — the lady could not move her bed, which must stay in the same position to the ventilator and the rope
